facts.text: The CJP's original X account (@CJP_2029, 200,000+ followers) was withheld in India under Section 69A of the IT Act, by a MeitY order dated 21 May 2026, reportedly on Intelligence Bureau inputs citing national security. Users saw 'Account Withheld in IN in response to a legal demand.'
facts.claimant: Delhi High Court order (email dated 21.05.2026); MeitY/IB per Indian Express via India.com

facts.text: Hours after the withholding, the CJP launched a new X account, 'Cockroach is Back' (@Cockroachisback), caption 'cockroaches don't die'; first post: 'You thought you can get rid of us? Lol!' Reports say 'hours' (Business Today) / 'less than two hours' (India.com), not 'minutes'. 49,100 followers within hours (FPJ, as of 7:10 pm).

facts.text: Delhi High Court (Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma) allowed Dipke's writ petition against the blocking order of 21.05.2026, ordering it revoked because NEET was over. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta: 'It was blocked at a time when NEET examination was to take place.' ... 'Now the examination is over.' ... 'I have no difficulty. I just want everyone to be more circumspect.' (FPJ). Court: 'Since NEET is already over, the primary concern is no longer of any relevance. In these circumstances, the order is revoked. The petition is allowed.' (PTI). LawBeat reports the order as: 'since the NEET Examinations are already over, the aforesaid primary concern of respondent no. 1 does not survive' and 'the impugned blocking order as referred in Email dated 21.05.2026' 'is directed to be revoked.'
facts.claimant: Delhi High Court; Solicitor General for the Union

facts.text: On 22 July the CJP Instagram account (@cockroachjantaparty) showed 'Account not available in India. This is because we complied with a legal request to restrict this content.' It was restored the same day, per Dipke ('It has been restored now'). IFF said no order had been published and the legal basis was unknown. Duration not stated.
